title: tragacantha khasiana
intro: Tragacantha khasiana, commonly known as the Himalayan hairgrass, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Tragacantha khasiana include its use in the treatment of various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Tragacantha khasiana contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
